items.title: RedHawks Run Past Kent State, 20-3

items.title: Tretter, Jones Named Skyline Athletes of the Week
items.summary: For their performances last week, Amber Tretter and D'Shawntae Jones are Miami's Athletes of the Week, presented by Skyline Chili for the week of November 16.

items.title: RedHawks Travel to Face Kent State Tuesday Night
items.summary: The Miami University football team plays at Kent State on Tuesday, Nov. 17. The contest is scheduled to begin at 7 p.m. on ESPNU.

items.title: RedHawks Hold Weekly Press Conference
items.summary: OXFORD, Ohio -- Miami University head football coach Chuck Martin, along with running back D'Shawntae Jones spoke with the local media on Thursday morning as the RedHawks prepare to face Kent State on Tuesday, Nov. 17.

items.title: 'Crazy, Crazy, Crazy': Miami's 34-Point Outburst Stuns Ohio
items.summary: OXFORD, Ohio— Every win in the Battle of the Bricks is memorable.   But some are especially memorable.   And Tuesday's 34-17 Miami victory in the 103rd edition of this historic rivalry was one for the record books.   The RedHawks overcame a 17-0 second-quarter deficit and ripped off 34 straight points to shock Ohio and hand the Bobcats their first conference loss of the season.

items.title: RedHawks Host Ohio on Senior Night
items.summary: The Miami University football team hosts the Ohio Bobcats on Tuesday, Nov. 10 inside Yager Stadium on ESPN2. Miami will also honor several seniors prior to the 8 p.m. start in the annual "Battle of the Bricks."

items.title: Football Holds Weekly Press Conference
items.summary: OXFORD, Ohio -- Miami University head football coach Chuck Martin, along with senior Grant Lyons, spoke with the local media on Thursday morning, prior to next Tuesday's matchup with Ohio University.

items.title: Buffalo Edges Miami 34-31 in OT
items.summary: OXFORD, Ohio— The Miami University football team fell to Buffalo 34-31 in overtime Tuesday night at Yager Stadium, snapping the RedHawks' three-game win streak. items.title: Time Change: Nov. 10 Contest Versus Ohio Moved to 8 p.m.
items.summary: OXFORD, Ohio – The Mid-American Conference has announced the Nov. 10 football contest versus Ohio has been moved to 8 p.m. and will be carried live on ESPN2. It is the final home contest of the season for the RedHawks.

items.title: RedHawks Put Win Streak on the Line Versus Buffalo on Tuesday
items.summary: The Miami University football team puts its three-game win streak on the line on Tuesday, Nov. 3 versus the Buffalo Bulls in a crucial Mid-American Conference matchup. The contest is scheduled to begin at 8 p.m. and be carried live on ESPN.
